cases.title: Danube InGrid · E.ON distribution grid
cases.setup: Three MV/LV on-load tap-changing transformers were installed in late 2024: 400 kVA in Paloznak and Komárom-Szőny, and 630 kVA in Jánossomorja. The sites targeted seasonal demand, PV-driven LV overvoltage and fluctuations on the incoming MV supply, respectively.
cases.finding: The grid-operator platform published voltage traces with and without control from one pilot location and reported acceptable voltage in initial observations. CINEA confirmed real-time operation in Hungary in June 2026.
cases.limit: The initial evaluation does not establish long-run performance, fleet-wide deployment counts or financial return.

cases.title: Smart Street · Electricity North West
cases.setup: The operator monitored radial LV feeder endpoints. The field trial included an OLTC-only test regime as well as separate combinations with capacitors and other network controls.
cases.finding: The operator documented the results in its close-out report and added the tested tap changer as an option in its distribution-transformer specification.
cases.limit: Do not read energy or loss results for the whole multi-technology programme as savings from the transformer alone.

sources.name: Electricity North West · close-out report, sections 3.3 and 9

cases.title: Voltage Optimization Unit · Technical University of Denmark
cases.setup: DTU tested a distribution transformer with single-phase on-load tap changers on a simplified experimental LV network at SYSLAB–PowerLabDK. Separate modelling used the Bistrup distribution grid as its case.
cases.finding: The lab report shows effective voltage-band control with remote measurement under the tested conditions and compares the experimental results with a PowerFactory model.
cases.limit: Bistrup results were simulations; the physical test took place in the lab, not on a live customer feeder.

scope: A starting point for transformer procurement and sourcing in Europe: EU-wide public notices, selected national portals in the EU and outside it, and a source-linked sample of manufacturers, component suppliers and test laboratories. This is not a complete list of European buyers or suppliers. Check the issuing buyer for amendments, deadlines, qualification and the actual submission channel.

portals.name: Tenders Electronic Daily (TED)
portals.description: Search EU public procurement notices by CPV, place of performance and notice type. TED publishes notices; use the buyer’s submission link and check local portals as well.

portals.name: Bekanntmachungsservice · Datenservice Öffentlicher Einkauf
portals.description: Search federal, state and municipal notices in one place. The notice tells you which platform handles documents and bids. Try Transformator or Leistungstransformator alongside CPV.

portals.name: BOAMP · Bulletin officiel des annonces des marchés publics
portals.description: Search French public notices and awards. Follow the buyer profile stated in the notice for documents and submission; for State procurement that may be PLACE.

portals.name: TenderNed
portals.description: Official Dutch tender platform. The application is in Dutch with English guides for foreign suppliers. Register your company if the buyer asks for submission in TenderNed.

portals.name: e-Zamówienia · Public Procurement Bulletin (BZP)
portals.description: Find domestic notices and procurement plans using buyer, CPV and deadline filters. Core tasks use the Polish interface; English guides explain registration and submission.

portals.name: Hilma
portals.description: Official service for upcoming and current procurement notices and results. Follow the notice’s instructions for documents, registration and where to bid.

portals.name: Find a Tender
portals.description: The UK’s central public procurement search. Scottish below-threshold opportunities use their own routes. For each notice, check the named submission channel and any required supplier registration.

portals.name: simap.ch
portals.description: Search federal, cantonal, municipal and associated buyers’ notices in German, French, Italian or English. Register and link a company account to submit online where the tender allows it.

portals.name: Doffin
portals.description: Norway’s public procurement notice database. Search the national source as well as TED and follow the buyer’s notice for the tender-management system and deadline.

companies.name: Siemens Energy · Nuremberg
companies.description: Large power transformer manufacturing in Nuremberg. The company announced an expansion in 2025; confirm current factory scope and lead time for the specific unit.

companies.name: Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen · Regensburg
companies.description: On-load tap-changer supplier. Compare product-specific through-current, equipment voltage and switch positions; catalogue inclusion does not establish interchangeability.

companies.name: Royal SMIT Transformers · Nijmegen
companies.description: SGB-SMIT identifies Nijmegen as its large power transformer manufacturing site. Confirm duties, test slots and scope with the supplier.

companies.name: KONČAR · Distribution and Special Transformers
companies.description: Zagreb OEM for medium-power, oil-filled and dry-type distribution, and special transformers. This business is distinct from the KONČAR–Siemens Energy large-power transformer joint venture.

companies.name: KONČAR Electrical Engineering Institute · Zagreb
companies.description: Publishes high-voltage type and special testing for power and instrument transformers. Confirm the specific method and current accreditation scope before booking.

companies.name: GE Vernova · Stafford
companies.description: GE Vernova identifies its Lichfield Road facility as an HVDC converter transformer manufacturing site. Its Stafford valve manufacturing is a separate operation.

companies.name: Weidmann Electrical Technology · Rapperswil
companies.description: Supplies cellulose-based Transformerboard in several densities for transformer insulation. Ask which grade and production location apply; do not infer site-specific manufacturing from a group catalogue.

companies.name: Hitachi Energy · Monselice
companies.description: Hitachi Energy describes Monselice, near Venice, as a power transformer facility serving renewables, data centers and transmission operators.

news.title: Hitachi Energy inaugurates the expanded Bad Honnef transformer factory
news.summary: Hitachi Energy says the German large power transformer site now has 15,000 square metres of production space. That measures floor area, not annual output or available capacity.

news.title: Fingrid signs for seven large power transformers from Hitachi Energy
news.summary: The supplier reports a signed Finnish order for seven 400 MVA, 400 kV transformers and an option for two more. The option is not a firm order; this is not open for bids.

news.title: KONČAR begins expanding its large-power transformer factory in Zagreb
news.summary: The KONČAR–Siemens Energy joint venture marked the start of an approximately €260 million expansion at Jankomir. The construction milestone does not mean the added lines are operating.

news.title: Siemens Energy reports a new wind-transformer factory open in Austria
news.summary: The Q1 shareholder letter says the Wollsdorf plant had opened after an investment of more than €100 million. The declared output of up to 2,000 offshore wind transformers a year is the facility’s stated potential, not actual production.

context.title: Search more than one transformer code
context.summary: Start with CPV 31170000 (transformers), 31171000 (liquid dielectric transformers) and 31213200 (distribution transformers). Also search transformer keywords and check lot descriptions, because mixed substation packages may use a broader main classification.

context.title: Check which EU ecodesign rules apply to the unit
context.summary: EU Regulation 548/2014, as amended by 2019/1783, sets ecodesign requirements for covered power transformers. Verify exclusions, loss limits and documentation against the unit and destination rather than assuming every transformer is covered.

context.title: Use the European Grids Package as context, not purchase evidence
context.summary: The European Commission’s package addresses grid planning, permitting and cross-border investment. It is market context rather than the award, purchase volume or delivery schedule for a specific transformer.
